release_notes:
1. Implemented GA4 add_shipping_info & add_payment_info: Dual server-side (actionCarrierProcess hook & checkout queue) and client-side lifecycle observers for carrier and payment method selection.
2. Complete GA4 schema compliance: currency, value, shipping_tier, payment_type, coupon, and items array.
3. Dynamic deduplication and method switching: Allows customers to change carriers or payment options without duplicate event firing while accurately updating the data layer.
